ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white/light-grey mottled blobs concentrated in the central region surrounding the median notch; low-intensity dark pixels dominate the peripheral trailing edges and the outer thirds of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree internal angle; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the vertical pixel height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing boundary with low-amplitude serrations (2-8 pixel amplitude); distinct indentations visible on the inner margin of the right lobe; boundary remains continuous but non-linear across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep along the trailing edges, diverging from the central axis towards the lateral tips; outer lobe margins exhibit moderate convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast pixel clusters on the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white pixel groups (diameter < 15 pixels) distributed across the dark-pigmented central and left fluke regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the mid-right lobe; short horizontal scratches visible near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive multi-tonal (brown/white) calcified barnacle encrustations on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes; irregular depigmentation and small notches along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Brownish-yellow pigmentation localized within the barnacle clusters on the lobe tips, providing a high-contrast color deviation from the monochromatic grey-scale fluke surface.
